scope: Independent read-only source review, no tests, compiler, NATS or Docker execution.

historicalFinding.finding: The original new control reused broker and TLS helpers that ignored cleanup results and registered log cleanup only after successful Start; returned request cleanup ownership was not registered before assertions.
historicalFinding.resolution: Dedicated helper registers exact log before Start, exact cmd after Start, exact dialers before Connect; all cleanup results checked. Request has sole result join on fatal paths and retains exact top-level TransportCleanupError before assertions.

productionReview: Exact observed context sentinels alone provide private deadline provenance; no Unwrap, Is or As changes operational behavior.
Authority sentinel identity, hard authentication and LastError ordering, cleanup priority and bounded projector traversal remain intact.
Value and pointer presentation use old fixed error text; JSON exposes no private context field.
Generic publish, flush, time-remaining-only and TLS label failures do not invent context provenance.
cleanupReview: Original thirty-second context is created before acquisitions and its cleanup is registered first so cancellation runs last.
Broker uses original CommandContext, exact cmd.Process SIGTERM and sole checked Wait; only original deadline SIGKILL is accepted fallback.
No historical startBroker or rawTLSClient helper is called; the new helper owns its broker and HOST dialer once.
Failed connection dialers remain captured for the registered exact retry; raw Close is checked before NATS Close.
Subscription Unsubscribe is checked; request cancellation and sole result join precede its exact cleanup attempt on every fatal path.
limits: Source clearance only; no actual controls executed by this reviewer.
Synchronous physical Wait and Close are not proven hard-preemptible; observed cleanup failures fail the test rather than qualify clean ownership.
Controlled Docker inspection remains synthetic. No actual engine, original warm failure cause, native host or phase acceptance.
